pipeline._comment_seed: null = different results every run (recommended). Set an integer here to reproduce a specific run exactly.

camera._comment_motion: Motion blur parameters — how far the camera moves between animation frames
camera._comment_dof: Focus-stack effect: each blur shot gets its own random aperture + focus distance, and the focus racks slightly (focus_rack_range) during the simulated exposure, same as the camera motion does.

lighting._comment_hdri: Set randomise_hdri true once you have .hdr/.exr files in hdri_directory. Overrides the sun+flat-sky lighting above.

asset_pipeline._comment: Curated Poly Haven / manual asset pool integration. When enabled, this takes over the floor texture and adds randomised models from your curated pools on top of whatever scene_file/procedural scene you're using. Requires machine_config.json and asset_pools.json to exist (see the .example.json templates) - machine_config.json is NOT portable between machines, edit its paths for each computer before running there.
asset_pipeline._comment_checkpoint: Percentage of num_renders between fresh asset selections (which HDRI/floor/models are loaded). Positions/rotations of whatever's currently loaded still randomise every render regardless of this value.
asset_pipeline._comment_source_mode: 'curated' reads asset_pools.json as-is (default). 'auto_discover' scans poly_haven_library_path directly and classifies every asset from its own info.json - no need to list Poly Haven assets in asset_pools.json manually. Manual-source entries in asset_pools.json are still included either way, since they have no info.json to auto-classify from.
asset_pipeline._comment_category_allowlist: Only used in auto_discover mode. If non-empty, only Poly Haven assets whose info.json 'categories' list intersects this list are included - e.g. ["props", "decorative"]. Empty list = no filtering (everything discovered is included).

scene_objects._comment: Names of objects to randomise position/rotation for. If using the built-in procedural test scene and these are left empty, the pipeline auto-fills them with the test primitives (Cube, Sphere, etc). Once you load your own .blend via blender.scene_file, list your actual object names here.

blender._comment_scene: Path to your .blend scene file. Leave empty to use a procedural scene.
